{"id":"vouch-xlha.21","title":"tiers: any maintainer can demote a peer maintainer, backdated","description":"Any maintainer can demote a peer maintainer and choose when the old tier ended.

Where (HEAD 4237c43): may_grant at git-vouch:1754-1756 compares the approver only with the tier being granted, never with the tier being replaced. tier_ends at 1926-1929 ends the replaced tier at the new record's signer-chosen `date`.

Reproduced (scratchpad a1/peer.sh): linus makes bob and carol maintainers. carol signs tiers/bob.json = contributor, dated 2026-10-23T00:00:00Z, which is earlier than bob's own promotion record. check: "bob contributor", exit 0, no warning. `export --min-tier maintainer` drops bob entirely, because until <= key.added. Every tag bob signed as a maintainer stops verifying against the maintainer file.

So any one of the roughly 1,000 maintainers can strip any other maintainer of the tier, retroactively, with a record that check accepts. DESIGN.md says "The approver must sit above the tier they grant", which literally allows this, but its accepted-risk list does not mention it. The rest of the design assumes demotion comes from whoever granted the tier or from above (DESIGN.md Tier record, "Demotion").

Fix (decision needed): a replacement record's approver must also sit strictly above the tier it replaces, so only an anchor can demote a maintainer. Require its `date` to be no earlier than the replaced record's `date` and the replacing commit's parent. If peer demotion is intended, say so in DESIGN.md under "Merging needs one person" and have check warn on it.

new_value: {"notes":"DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-23): (a). Only someone above a person's current tier may change (lower) it: in practice an anchor demotes a maintainer. A tier record lowering someone, signed by a peer or someone below, is void. 'Current tier' is the tier held when the record is merged, judged from git history (so backdating the record's date does not help). Mirrors promotion (only an approver above grants). DESIGN How trust maps states it. Queued after the review-fixes workflow (wf_f518f833-7e4) releases git-vouch: needs a regression test from the reviewer's repro (/home/mark/PROJECT/git-vouch/../ scratchpad/a1) and the DESIGN line."}
